blocks.goal: Reduce ClassInjector's fan-out by extracting the instrumentation-based injection responsibility (large I/O and instrumentation dependencies) into a separate top-level class so that ClassInjector no longer directly depends on java.lang.instrument.Instrumentation, java.util.jar.JarFile/JarOutputStream, java.util.zip.ZipFile and net.bytebuddy.utility.RandomString from its file-level imports.

ops.details: Move the nested static class ClassInjector.UsingInstrumentation (the entire class body: fields, constructors, nested enums and methods) into a new top-level class net.bytebuddy.dynamic.loading.UsingInstrumentation in the same package. Keep the public API identical (static factory methods such as of(File, Target, Instrumentation) remain static on the new top-level class). Remove instrumentation-specific imports from ClassInjector.java and add them only to the new UsingInstrumentation.java file. Preserve the nested Target enum as a public or package-private nested type inside the new class if required or as a top-level nested enum within UsingInstrumentation to keep compilation local to the new file.

Remove imports used exclusively by the extracted UsingInstrumentation implementation (java.io.File, java.io.FileOutputStream, java.io.OutputStream, java.util.jar.JarEntry, java.util.jar.JarFile, java.util.jar.JarOutputStream, java.util.zip.ZipFile, java.security.PrivilegedAction, java.lang.instrument.Instrumentation, net.bytebuddy.utility.RandomString). Ensure remaining imports for ClassInjector stay intact. Add those imports to the new UsingInstrumentation.java file.

inputs: byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/**/ (all call sites referencing ClassInjector.UsingInstrumentation in this module)
ops.details: Update references that previously used the nested type ClassInjector.UsingInstrumentation to reference the new top-level type net.bytebuddy.dynamic.loading.UsingInstrumentation. This includes any code that invoked UsingInstrumentation.of(...) or referenced UsingInstrumentation.Target. Keep method signatures identical so minimal changes are required in callers.

blocks.goal: Reduce ClassInjector's fan-out by extracting the JNA-based injection responsibility into a separate top-level class so that ClassInjector no longer directly depends on com.sun.jna types (FunctionMapper, JNIEnv, LastErrorException, Library, Native, NativeLibrary, Platform) and the JNA Dispatcher plumbing.

ops.details: Move the nested static class ClassInjector.UsingJna (its Dispatcher interface, CreationAction, Enabled/Unavailable implementations and the Jvm interface) into a new top-level class net.bytebuddy.dynamic.loading.UsingJna in the same package. Keep public factory methods (ofSystemLoader, ofPlatformLoader, ofBootLoader) and injectRaw/isAvailable implementations unchanged but located in the new file. Remove JNA-specific imports from ClassInjector.java and confine them to the new UsingJna.java file.

Remove com.sun.jna.* and related imports from ClassInjector.java (FunctionMapper, JNIEnv, LastErrorException, Library, Native, NativeLibrary, Platform) and add these imports to the new UsingJna.java file. Ensure any imports required for the extracted class (e.g. java.io.IOException, java.util.Map, java.util.HashMap, java.util.Locale) are present in UsingJna.java.

inputs: byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/**/ (all call sites referencing ClassInjector.UsingJna in this module)
ops.details: Replace usages of the nested type ClassInjector.UsingJna with the new top-level net.bytebuddy.dynamic.loading.UsingJna. Keep the API surface unchanged so callers require minimal edits.
